title: Transport materializes; it does not decide
summary: Local directory, managed ZIP and Git branch transports all converge on the same AlchemyMaterializedPackage shape. The transport layer owns safe materialization and source provenance, not domain planning or execution policy.
invariants: Every materialized package must contain integration.json at its root.
Git branch transport reads an exact immutable commit/subtree; branch checkout/merge is not required.
Managed ZIP transport validates archive paths before extraction.
Transport source records kind, locator, immutable identity, submission id and package path.

provenance.claim: Transport boundary and common materialized-package contract.
Managed ZIP and Git branch materialization implementations.
